author: Rainstruck
body:
I am proud to announce the Ravish Brother's Very First Map...




The Creators for this map are: RileGuy and Lavish.







We had many contributors and we would like to thank them all for everything that they have done for this map! It was a really big project and we are finally glad to release in the coming days

Gamemode: DTM 
Team Names: Valhalla V.S Callisto

Download: https://www.dropbox.com/s/6s6wjg0r1v8s7d1/RileGuy2.zip?dl=0
YML: http://pastebin.com/w0buueNv
Gallery: http://imgur.com/a/Ql0Ce

If you guys have any feedback please let me and Cal know! Any Feedback is greatly appreciated!

-Riley and Cal
